svg.aria-label: Table-like diagram mapping DSCP values to switch priorities, traffic classes, queue properties and scheduler weights for RoCE data CNP and best effort
svg.title: Classification chain: DSCP -> switch priority -> traffic class -> egress queue and scheduler
svg.text: Classification chain: DSCP -> switch priority -> traffic class -> egress queue and scheduler
What 'nv set qos roce mode lossless' programs on a Spectrum switch, and the matching NIC side
NIC side (mlnx_qos): trust dscp; dscp2prio 24-31 -> prio 3, 48-55 -> prio 6 (defaults); --pfc 0,0,0,1,0,0,0,0;
--prio_tc 0,0,0,3,0,0,6,0; --tsa/--tcbw for ETS shares. PCP (802.1p) only exists on tagged links and is lost
at L3: trust DSCP for routed RoCE v2. Conventions, not laws (some sites use DSCP 24 for data); every box must agree.
Observe: ethtool -S | grep rx_prio3_bytes (RoCE really in prio 3?), nv show qos roce, nv show interface swp1 qos roce status.
